physicalNotes: Radius 0.76 Jupiter radii from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since 55 Cnc c does not transit (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html): 54,333.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.1781 +/- 0.0069 Jupiter masses (Moutou et al. (2026), A&A 705, A190, Table 3: minimum mass (m sin i) 56.6 +/- 2.2 Earth masses from the star's radial velocities; at the assumed tilt of 93.9 degrees the mass is 0.2% more, https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11523) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.period: Moutou et al.
